name: cleardesk
description: ClearDesk: a chat-first project workspace for Obsidian, powered by Claude.

scripts.build: node esbuild.config.mjs && cp manifest.json styles.css build/
scripts.test:ai: set -e; for h in ai-harness stream-harness attach-harness files-harness memory-harness; do esbuild test/harness/$h.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --alias:obsidian=./test/harness/obsidian-stub.ts --outfile=test/harness/$h.mjs --log-level=warning; node test/harness/$h.mjs 2>/dev/null || { echo "FAILED: $h"; exit 1; }; done

author: Alexander (https://github.com/Al-p-i)
